name: SplitPolyByLine
formula: =LAMBDA(vertices,xp,yp,xq,yq,LET(originShapeArr, vertices, Intersects, {ref}PolyAndLineIntersection(originShapeArr, xp, yp, xq, yq), numOfIntersections, ROWS(Intersects), iterations, SEQUENCE(numOfIntersections / 2), output, IF(numOfIntersections = 2, {ref}SplitPolyIntoTwoPolys(originShapeArr, xp, yp, xq, yq), {ref}SplitPolysIteration(originShapeArr, Intersects)), output))
comment: Split a shape (defined by array of points) by a line. Last Update at 2024-06-23. Return an array of the shapes, each entity in the array contains the points of that shape.
